model_interpretation: Set order improves the workload model, but this is a protocol/progression proxy.
Low-dimensional IMU trend improves the workload/dose model on the VO2-overlap subset.
Full RPE-only evidence is weaker; the gain is relative to workload/dose, not to exercise mean.
45 s delayed VO2 gives the clearest additional gain after low-dimensional IMU trend.
kg, n_reps, and total_tut_sec define the workload/dose control baseline.
